final_message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and the full suite is green (18 pass, 0 fail).

**The bug:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 came out as "¥5.00".

**The fix:** I added a set of zero-decimal currencies (currently just `JPY`). For those, the amount is printed as whole units with no division. Everything else still divides by 100. Invoices, cart totals and receipts all go through this function, so they get the same correction.

I didn't commit the change. Only `src/utils/money.js` is modified. The yen-specific test already existed, so I didn't add one.

If you'll be using other zero-decimal currencies (KRW, VND, CLP, ISK and so on), they need adding to `ZERO_DECIMAL`. Right now only JPY is handled.
